record_scope_reconstruction: Thai outbound traveller restriction at the main Three Pagodas crossing during November 2019 fighting. Refugees entering Thailand and other traffic categories are not assumed stopped.

source_checks.finding: Thaiger reports the pass closed since Wednesday fighting and authorities preventing Thais crossing into Myanmar. Its Bangkok Post-derived origin is retained.
Main Three Pagodas road border-control node inspected; appropriate to the stated ordinary traveller crossing, not an unnamed truck gate.

sites.name: Three Pagodas Pass local road checkpoint
sites.coordinate_method: Fresh OSM API XML node coordinates
sites.precision: Approximate crossing area, about 100 m; not the historical barrier footprint
sites.evidence_note: Road border_control node immediately north of the three pagodas; small-area OSM extract separates the node from the pagoda monuments. Thai tourism authority identifies Highway 323 ending at this pass; original July 2017 reporting identifies the local commuter checkpoint.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification:
R4-EA-004-R1: Underlying reporting shares Bangkok Post origin; indexed access. Does not infer all freight, refugee or Myanmar worker closure; March 2020 reopening unrelated.

continuity: Thaiger's November 29 report describes Three Pagodas closure since Wednesday fighting, specifically preventing Thais entering Myanmar while Mon civilians fled into Thailand. This supports the selective November 27–29 observation; freight and returnee access cannot be assumed closed.

Source correction: the Irrawaddy article dated 18 October 2019 concerns earlier Karen–Mon fighting and predates this November 27 episode. It supplies no evidence of this closure’s continuity or reopening. December 4 villagers returning within Myanmar likewise does not establish restored Thai outbound ordinary-traveller access.

independence_statement: Pass B reconstruction from original-source retrievals and coordinate evidence; no pass A files or judgments consulted.
